audit.whatIsWrong: Thunderclap is called a 'W passive auto-shred' twice, Granite Shield's shield is attributed to his W, and Unstoppable Force is called point-and-click.
audit.why: Three errors against Riot's text. Thunderclap is 'attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him' — on-hit splash damage, no shred at all. What actually degrades your trades is Ground Slam (E), which 'reduces the Attack Speed of enemies' and deals damage based on his Armor, so every armour item he buys is also a damage item. That is the real reason trading into a stacking tank goes bad, and the page attributes it to the wrong ability. The shield is Granite Shield, his passive, not his W. And Unstoppable Force is a launch to a location, not a point-and-click — you can sidestep the landing, which matters when the page tells you to simply avoid fighting near it.
audit.corrected: Thunderclap restated as on-hit splash, the attack-speed cut and armour-scaling moved to Ground Slam, the shield returned to Granite Shield, and Unstoppable Force described as a location charge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Granite Shield's recharge rule is never stated, and it is the single most exploitable thing in his kit for a poke laner.
audit.why: Riot: 'shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.' Against a champion whose plan is repeated Comet Spear poke, that is a direct instruction — chip him on a rhythm and the shield never comes back, walk away and you have handed him a free 10% health bar every few seconds. Nothing on the page mentioned it.

Seismic Shard is 8s flat and Ground Slam 7s flat, so his poke and his attack-speed cut are both permanently available — there is no gap to wait for, which is why the plan has to be level-based rather than cooldown-based. Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1, and that one you can wait out. Thunderclap is 10s down to 8s.
audit.corrected: The 130s and the flat 7-8s point written into mid.

edits.before: His R unstoppable charge is his first real threat — it can lock you for a jungler gank or flip a trade you started.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is his first real threat — a 130s launch to a spot, so sidestep the landing or wait it out entirely.

edits.before: Malphite stacks armor (Iceborn/Sunfire) and his W passive auto-shred starts eating your AD trades hard.
edits.after: Malphite stacks armour, and Ground Slam's damage scales off it — every armour item is also a damage item.

edits.before: Punish every Malphite Q he throws to last-hit — close the mana/HP gap
edits.after: Poke on a rhythm so Granite Shield never gets its few seconds to recharge

edits.after: Granite Shield and climbing armour stabilise the lane as your kill pressure dips — a genuine coinflip now.

edits.before: His first armor item plus W auto-shred turns your AD trades sour while your kit's damage plateaus.
edits.after: His first armour item makes Ground Slam hit harder both ways, and your own damage plateaus.

edits.before: Malphite is one of the softest level-1 to level-3 laners in the game and you are one of the strongest — abuse it. Lead with aimed Q from max range to chunk him while he has to walk up and Q to last-hit, and watch his mana bleed. At 2 you can W-stun in, Q, and walk out before he has armor or a W shield to punish you. Your E directional block also eats his Q poke cleanly if he tries to trade back. This is your whole game: get him low and force a kill before his armor exists.
edits.after: Malphite is one of the softest level-1 to level-3 laners in the game and you are one of the strongest — abuse it. Lead with aimed Comet Spear at max range while he walks up to last-hit, and watch his mana bleed. Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his max health but only recharges if he has not been hit for a few seconds, so poke on a rhythm and it never comes back. At 2, Shield Vault in, spear, and leave before armour exists. Face Aegis Assault at Seismic Shard if he trades back.

edits.before: By 4-5 you still control the lane with empowered-Q poke, but start respecting level 6: his R is an unstoppable point-and-click engage that can flip a trade or set up his jungler the moment you W in. Don't W-stun him into his own R range when his ult is up — bait it or wait it out. If you have a lead, stop trading into his stacking armor and instead cash it in with Grand Starfall roams to other lanes. Every minute you spend trading AD into a tank is value for him.
edits.after: By 4-5 you still control the lane with empowered Comet Spear, but there is no cooldown gap to farm: Seismic Shard is 8s flat and Ground Slam 7s flat, so his poke and your attack-speed cut are always available. Level 6 is what you count — Unstoppable Force is 130s and it launches to a spot, so you can sidestep the landing or simply refuse the wave while it is up. With a lead, stop trading into stacking armour and cash it with Grand Starfall roams instead.

edits.before: This is where Malphite simply wins. He builds nothing but armor — Sunfire, Iceborn, Thornmail — and your physical damage is hard-walled while his W passive auto-shred and R do real damage back to your squishy frame. Your kit plateaus the moment his second item lands. Do not 1v1 a full-tank Malphite late; you will not break him. Your only path is the lead you already built — take towers, group, and let your team's magic damage handle the armor stack. If lane was even, accept you've lost the side-lane duel and play for tempo elsewhere.
edits.after: This is where Malphite simply wins. He builds nothing but armour, your physical damage is hard-walled, and Ground Slam deals damage based on that same armour while cutting your attack speed — so his defence and his offence are the same purchase. Thunderclap adds on-hit splash on top of it. Do not 1v1 a full-tank Malphite late; you will not break him. Your only path is the lead you already built — take towers, group, and let your team magic damage handle the armour stack. If lane was even, concede the side-lane duel and play for tempo elsewhere.

Those two cells need a hand fix. KIT FLAG WARNING: champ-data/_kits/malphite.json tags BOTH Seismic Shard and Ground Slam with 'grounding'. Neither grounds — Riot's texts are a move-speed steal and an attack-speed reduction respectively, and the flag has almost certainly latched onto the word 'ground'. I did not write any grounding claim, and it matters here because grounding would deny Shield Vault and Grand Starfall, which would be a huge and completely false piece of advice. Content errors fixed: Thunderclap was called a 'W passive auto-shred' twice when it is on-hit splash with no shred; the attack-speed cut and the armour-scaling damage both belong to Ground Slam; the shield is Granite Shield, his passive, not his W; and Unstoppable Force is a launch to a location, not point-and-click.
